name: browser-use
headline: apple podcast downloader with smart search
short_description: A comprehensive Claude Code skill for searching, browsing, and downloading podcast episodes from Apple Podcasts. Features smart search with Unicode support, episode browsing, and audio download with progress tracking. Zero dependencies, no auth required.
author: crazynomad

sections.overview:
Apple Podcast Downloader is a Claude Code skill that lets you search Apple Podcasts by keyword, author, or topic, then browse episodes with rich metadata including titles, dates, durations, and descriptions. The skill downloads episodes as MP3 files with progress tracking and supports international content through full Unicode support for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and other languages. It uses the free Apple iTunes Search API with zero dependencies and no authentication required, making it accessible for anyone using Claude Code. Common workflows include searching for specific podcasts, listing recent episodes for user selection, and downloading individual or batch episodes.
Search for podcasts by keyword and download latest episodes automatically
Browse and list recent episodes from a specific podcast, then select which to download
Download multiple selected episodes from a podcast in batch
Search and download international podcasts using Chinese, Japanese, or Korean characters
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/crazynomad/apple-podcast-downloader`
sections.usage:
```
I want to download podcast episodes from Apple Podcasts using this Claude Code skill. Please search for the latest episodes of [PODCAST_NAME] and provide me with a list of the 5 most recent episodes. Then, download the audio files for episodes [EPISODE_NUMBERS] to my specified directory. Show me the progress as you go.
```
